description: Source code for the search layer of the Mattermost server, specifically managing channel indexing, updates, and autocompletion using search engines.

classes.name: SearchChannelStore
classes.description: A store managing channel search indexing, updates, and autocompletion, integrating with search engines and the channel store.

methods.name: deleteChannelIndex
methods.description: Deletes a channel from the search index if the channel is of open type.

methods.name: indexChannel
methods.description: Indexes a channel in all active search engines, including fetching channel members if private.

methods.name: bulkIndexChannels
methods.description: Bulk indexes multiple channels across all active search engines.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves a new channel and indexes it.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates a channel and reindexes it, reindexing posts if channel type changes.

methods.name: reindexChannelPosts
methods.description: Reindexes posts for a channel when its type changes.

methods.name: UpdateMember
methods.description: Updates a channel member and reindexes related user and channel data.

methods.name: SaveMember
methods.description: Saves a new channel member and updates related user and channel data.

methods.name: RemoveMember
methods.description: Removes a member from a channel and updates user index.

methods.name: RemoveMembers
methods.description: Removes multiple members from a channel and updates user index.

methods.name: CreateDirectChannel
methods.description: Creates a direct message channel between two users and indexes it.

methods.name: SaveDirectChannel
methods.description: Saves a direct message channel and indexes it.

methods.name: Autocomplete
methods.description: Provides channel autocomplete suggestions across all search engines, falling back to database if needed.

methods.name: AutocompleteInTeam
methods.description: Provides team-specific channel autocomplete suggestions, with fallback.

methods.name: searchAutocompleteChannels
methods.description: Performs search engine-based channel autocomplete within a team.

methods.name: searchAutocompleteChannelsAllTeams
methods.description: Performs search engine-based channel autocomplete across all teams.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteMembersByUser
methods.description: Permanently deletes all channel memberships for a user and updates indexes.

methods.name: RemoveAllDeactivatedMembers
methods.description: Removes deactivated members from a channel and updates user index.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteMembersByChannel
methods.description: Permanently deletes all members of a channel and updates user index.

methods.name: PermanentDelete
methods.description: Permanently deletes a channel and removes it from the search index.
